analyze_stage.metrics: core metrics plus correction_to_local_target, passes_frozen_newton_inequality, thermal

actual_only.execution_receipt: nonempty owner record locator; module records it and does not execute/read remote source
actual_only.added_rhs_evaluations: integer >=0, explicitly captured rather than inferred

validation.actual_acceptance: Computed native_scaled_residual_inf<=1e-11 required for packet claiming accepted stage; otherwise HOLD_ACCEPTED_STAGE_RESIDUAL_MISMATCH
validation.stale: Exact supplied numeric state/context mismatch yields HOLD_STALE_OR_MISMATCHED_STAGE
validation.source: Actual driver blob must match pinned residual implementation; mismatch HOLD_SOURCE_BINDING_MISMATCH, not automatic scientific-invalidity finding
validation.missing: Missing required packet fields or absent file => HOLD_MISSING_STAGE_DATA
validation.conditioning: Finite condition estimate reported with no threshold; zero pivot HOLD_SINGULAR_JACOBIAN; nonfinite arithmetic HOLD_NONFINITE_ARITHMETIC

thermal.invalid_corrected_state: Keep linear diagnostic; exact_delta andtemperature_corrected null, corrected_domainINVALID and reason; no clipping
thermal.finite_rounding: All evaluated formulas binary64; exact_map denotes algebraic EOS map rather than exact arithmetic or true temperature error
